_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee ciyaarta Liar's Dice ee {num_players} ciyaaryahan. Xeerarka: - Marka aad soo wareegto, waxaad: 1) ku bixin kartaa dalab cusub oo leh tiro ka badan ama waji ka sareeya (ama labadaba) marka loo eego dalabka hadda jira; ie '[Bid: 3, 4]', 2) Wac dalabkii ugu dambeeyay adoo qoraya '[Call]'. Haddii aad wacdo: - Haddii tirada dhabta ah ee qiimaha wajiga ee dhammaan lacagaha ay ka yar yihiin dalabka, kan ugu dambeeya ee bixiya ayaa luminaya hal lacagaha. - Haddii kale, kan wacaya ayaa luminaya hal lacagaha. Ciyaaryahankii gaadha 0 lacagaha ayaa la tirtirayaa. Ciyaaryahankii ugu dambeeyay ee haray ayaa guuleysta.

board.new_round: Wareeg cusub - Dhibcaha haray: {dice_summary} Dhibcahaaga hadda jira waa: {your_dice}

call.bidder_loses: Ciyaaryahanka {current_player_id} ayaa wacaya! Tirada dhabta ah ee wajiga {face_value} waa {count}, taas oo ka yar {quantity}. Ciyaaryahanka {loser_id} (qofka ugu dambeeya ee bixiya) ayaa lumiya hal dhimasho.
call.caller_loses: Ciyaaryahanka {current_player_id} ayaa wacaya! Tirada dhabta ah ee wajiga {face_value} waa {count}, taas oo ah >= {quantity}. Ciyaaryahanka {loser_id} (wixii wacaya) ayaa lumiya hal dhimasho.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Wicitaan la sameeyay iyada oo aan la soo bandhigin wax dalab ah.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Dacwad aan loo aqoonsanayn mid sax ah "[Bid: X, Y]" ama "[Call]". Dacwad la gudbiyay: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Tirada cusub {new_quantity} waa ka yar tahay tirada hadda jirta {current_quantity}.
bid_reason.face_lower: Qiimaha cusub ee magaca ah {new_face_value} waa ka hooseeyaa kan hadda jira {current_face_value}.
bid_reason.identical: Lacagta la bixiyay waa la mid.
bid_reason.face_range: Qiimaha muuqaalka waa inuu u dhaxeeya 1 iyo 6.

message.eliminated_invalid: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} waxaa lagu saaray ciyaar aan ansax ahayn.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {winner} ayaa guuleysta! Darajada ugu dambeysa: {final_ranking}
